description: 대전광역시 유성구_차량 등록 대수 대비 동별 전기차 현황 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 유성구. 대전광역시 유성구 전기차 등록 대수 대비 동별 충전소 현황에 대한 데이터로 동별 차 등록대수, 전기차등록대수, 설치년도 등의 항목을 제공합니다. Coverage: 대전광역시 유성구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 유성구. Its tags are 전기차등록대수, 동별 차 등록대수, 전기차, 환경기상. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2022-12-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
